title: The Police Service of Scotland (Senior Officers) (Conduct) Amendment Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Police Service of Scotland (Senior Officers) (Conduct) Regulations 2013 (“the 2013 Regulations”), which make provision for the procedures to be followed where the conduct of a senior officer of the Police Service of Scotland is alleged to amount to misconduct or gross misconduct.

title: The Police Service of Scotland (Conduct) Amendment Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Police Service of Scotland (Conduct) Regulations 2014 (“the 2014 Conduct Regulations”), which make provision for the procedures to be followed where the conduct of a constable of the Police Service of Scotland is alleged to amount to misconduct or gross misconduct.

title: The Social Security (Amendment) (Scotland) Act 2025 (Commencement No. 3) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations bring into force section 19 of the Social Security (Amendment) (Scotland) Act 2025 on 2 November 2026 but only for the purpose of exercising the regulation-making powers in new Part 6A of the Social Security (Scotland) Act 2018 specified in column 1 of the table in the schedule.

The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) (Amendment) (No. 2) Order 2026
summary: This Order amends the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (S.I. 2015/596) (“the GPDO”). The GPDO provides, for the purposes of section 59 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (c. 8), for the grant of planning permission for certain classes of development without the requirement for a planning application to be made under Part 3 of that Act. The classes of permission, known as “permitted development rights” together with their accompanying conditions, limitations and restrictions, are set out in Schedule 2 to the GPDO.

title: The M25 Junction 10/A3 Wisley Interchange Development Consent (Amendment) Order 2026
summary: This Order amends the M25 Junction 10/A3 Wisley Interchange Development Consent Order 2022 (“the 2022 Order”), a development consent order under the Planning Act 2008 (“the Act”).

title: The Gatwick Airport (Northern Runway Project) Development Consent (Correction) Order 2026
summary: This Order corrects errors and omissions in the Gatwick Airport (Northern Runway Project) Development Consent Order 2025 (S.I. 2025/1054), a development consent order under the Planning Act 2008, following a request under paragraph 1(5)(a) of Schedule 4 to that Act.

The Recovery of Health Services Charges (Amounts) (Amendment) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2026
summary: The Recovery of Health Services Charges (Northern Ireland) Order 2006 provides for a scheme for the recovery of charges in cases where an injured person who receives a compensation payment in respect of his injury has received hospital treatment or ambulance services. The charges are specified in certificates issued by the Department for Communities and are payable by persons who pay compensation to the injured person. The charges in each case are calculated by reference to a tariff of charges provided for by the Recovery of Health Services Charges (Amounts) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2006 (“the principal Regulations”).

title: The Batteries (Placing on the Market) (Northern Ireland) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make provision for the implementation in Northern Ireland of Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 12 July 2023 concerning batteries and waste batteries, amending Directive 2008/98/EC and Regulation (EU) 2019/1020 and repealing Directive 2006/66/EC (OJ L 191, pp. 1 - 117) (“Regulation (EU) 2023/1542”).

title: The Green Gas Support Scheme (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations, which apply in Great Britain, amend the Green Gas Support Scheme Regulations 2021 (S.I. 2021/1335) (“the 2021 Regulations”), which established the Green Gas Support Scheme (“the GGSS”). The GGSS is a renewable heat incentive scheme designed to support the production of biomethane by anaerobic digestion for injection into the gas grid.
